faq.q: Which areas in Gandhinagar do 64 Realtors cover?
faq.a: We specialize in prime areas including Kudasan, Raysan, Urjanagar, Randesan, Bhaijipura, GIFT City road corridor, Infocity, and surrounding high-growth sectors.

faq.q: How do you verify property documentation and titles?
faq.a: We thoroughly examine revenue records, 7/12 & 8A extracts, NA orders, RERA registration, TP/DP zoning, and municipal approvals before onboarding any listing.

faq.q: Can I arrange a personalized site visit?
faq.a: Yes! You can contact Dipak Prajapati (+91 97266 59963) or Suryarajsinh Chauhan (+91 70960 06464) directly via Phone or WhatsApp to schedule a convenient visit.

faq.q: Do you assist with home loans and legal registration?
faq.a: Yes, we provide complete assistance with bank home loans, legal drafting, stamp duty calculations, and the sub-registrar office registration process.
